scenes.text: The context window challenge: how do we process documents longer than the model's memory?
scenes.title: The Problem

scenes.text: A query arrives. The model must decide how to approach it.
scenes.title: Query Arrival

scenes.text: The model decomposes the problem into sub-queries, each handled by a recursive call.
scenes.title: Recursive Decomposition

scenes.text: Each sub-LLM processes its chunk independently, using tools like grep, peek, and summarize.
scenes.title: Parallel Processing

scenes.text: Results are aggregated into the final answer. This is the power of recursive language models.
scenes.title: Synthesis
